name: Mandatory Disclosure of Federal Award Violations
description: Prompt written disclosure of credible evidence of federal criminal fraud, conflict of interest, bribery or gratuity violations, or False Claims Act violations; also recipient integrity and performance reporting per Appendix XII.
recipient: Federal agency, its Office of Inspector General, and pass-through entity
quote: The written disclosure must be made to the federal agency, the agency's Office of Inspector General, and pass-through entity (if applicable).
